body.label: Trigger
body.html: An ally within 5 units would be forced to move, become Prone, or break a declared Vow condition.

body.label: Effect
body.html: The ally may ignore 1 unit of forced movement, remain standing, or delay the Vow consequence until the end of its turn.

surges.html: If you become or remain a legal target of the triggering effect, one affected ally becomes Rallied.
If an enemy triggered this Reaction, it becomes Exposed if it ignores you on its next Action.
